headline: AMD posts record $13.4 billion quarter on data center strength
summary: AMD reported record quarterly revenue of $13.4 billion, which CEO Lisa Su called the company's largest and most profitable quarter ever, driven by its data center business. Ars Technica reports that while the data center segment doubled, AMD's gaming revenue fell 40 percent during the same quarter.
